testcase.name: real city response keeps ambiguous towns separate with their region
city query is encoded once without changing parameters
partial Overpass response and invalid JSON are failures rather than empty success
expired cache survives network failure with its old date and an explicit reason
malformed and ineligible elements are rejected individually
real churches use orthodox tags and stable source IDs without inferring schedule
cache older than seven days or from the future is never used
invalid query coordinates and radius never send requests
query centers and haversine remain valid at map boundaries
real Petersburg response removes unnamed objects and bell towers
broken cache and failed cache writes cannot break a valid search
changed provider cannot reuse results from the previous endpoint
large responses are rejected even with an injected transport
malformed city geometry cannot become a selectable zero coordinate
fresh cache avoids a second request but a different query cannot reuse it
cancellation is not converted to an offline result
